miko: Quick noisy onboarding report for oxide-v1 (hybrid-int4 bringup). Seeing weird zero-width-space insertions inside CJK tokens and bidirectional parenthesis flips in mixed he/zh and ar/zh prompts—but only under stochastic sampling. Greedy/beam look normal. Anyone else hit ZWSP or bidi reordering only during sampling with int-ish quant? :eyes:
arjun: paste a tiny repro + how you ran it?
miko: ran on dedicated-staging, quant=hybrid-int4 (activation int4 / embedding q8), sampler=nucleus p=0.92 temp=0.85. Short stats + example below.
```
# quick stats (n=100 samples / locale)
locale mean_entropy token_split_rate zwsp_hits kl_vs_en
en     3.0          0.01           0        0.0
zh     5.6          0.09           7        1.9
he     4.5          0.05           3        1.1
ar     4.3          0.06           4        0.9
# example src zh: "\u8bf7\u63d0\u4f9b\u60a8\u7684\u5730\u5740\u3002"
# sample shows invisible zwsp inserted inside grapheme clusters:
sampleA: "\u8bf7\u63d0\u200b\u4f9b\u60a8\u7684\u5730\u5740\u3002"
sampleB: "\u8bf7\u63d0\u4f9b\u60a8\u7684 \u5730\u5740\u3002"
# mixed hebrew+zh src: "\u05d0\u05d0 \u548c example (user) \u4fe1\u606f"
sample: "\u05d0\u05d0 example )user( \u4fe1\u606f"
```

arjun: Interesting. Two directions: tokenizer/detok path, and runtime numeric stability in the sampling path. Greedy unaffected → tail logits jitter. ZWSP insertion is nasty because it's invisible and breaks downstream token contiguity.
tess: Can you confirm whether the detok codepath for sampling differs from greedy? We introduced an "adaptive-detok" fast-path in the int-optimized runtime last month. infra-bot: deploy note: "adaptive-detok-fastpath" and "hybrid-int4-softmax-opt" rolled to staging (deploy ids rel-2026-03-25, rel-2026-03-26).
miko: I forced --detok=utf8-normalize and reran with n=64. zwsp_hits dropped from 7 -> 2 and token_split_rate fell by ~40% for zh, but still above float baseline. Lowering temp to 0.6 reduces splits but doesn't eliminate them.
leon: I suspect two possible root causes: 1) tokenizer utf8/byte-path aliasing where certain subtokens are emitted with surrounding zero-width separators under fast detok, 2) quantization-induced rounding that narrows logits between many CJK subtokens so sampling picks neighboring subtokens occasionally. Which one is it? We need matrix tests.
arjun: Agreed. Plan: run a 3x2 matrix: (weights float / hybrid-int4 / full-int8) x (runtime softmax fused / unfused) with detok forced to both fast-byte and utf8-normalize. Collect per-step softmax pre-activations and token rank jitter for curated prompt set. n=64 to keep runs quick. I'll queue it.
tess: Also add a tiny deterministic test: for a fixed seed sampling, compare emitted token codepoints between float and quant runs. If they diverge early, it's kernel math; if they only diverge after many tokens, could be sampling nondeterminism amplified.
ci-bot: CI job ci-7432 queued: oxide-v1 hybrid-int4 sampling matrix (run id: ci-7432). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/ci-7432 :rocket:
miko: I dumped logits for one problematic prefix and uploaded to gist (private): https://gist.github.com/redwood/oxide-hybrid-int4-logits. The plot shows many CJK subtokens within ~1e-3 probability mass for the quant run vs a clearer head in float.
leon: If matrix implicates "hybrid-int4-softmax-opt" fused kernel, we should consider reverting it for staging or falling back to unfused softmax for CJK locales in onboarding. For detok fastpath, if forcing utf8-normalize reduces zwsp, we likely have a preproc aliasing bug.
arjun: For short-term mitigation, propose: 1) set onboarding sampler recommendation for CJK → top-p=0.85,temp=0.6 for hybrid-int4; 2) add gating rule: if zwsp_hits > 2 per 100 samples OR token_split_rate_delta(CJK) > 0.04 vs float baseline, block onboarding; 3) add a unit check comparing token contiguity and invisible-char insertions between float and quant.
tess: Good. Also add an instrumentation hook to flag invisible control characters in sampled outputs automatically in onboarding pipeline. Prevent silent regressions.
miko: Opening ML-1980 with examples, logits, and CI id ci-7432. Assign @arjun to run matrix + bisect, @leon to evaluate potential hotfix/revert, @tess to add unit tests/zwsp detector. I'll attach the prompt set to /datasets/onboard/oxide/zwsp-spot.json. Update in ~4h. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: FYI if we need a quick revert tag for detok fastpath, use label "hotfix/detok-fastpath" and ping releases.
leon: one more ask  add locale-specific sampling smoke in onboarding: run 5 CJK prompts + 5 mixed RTL prompts under default sampling and fail if any invisible-char detected. That should catch most of these.
arjun: queued bisect across commits touching softmax/detok between abcdef1..fedcba9. ETA ~3h for initial signal.
ci-bot: will post results to ML-1980 when ready.
